# Prados Restaurant & Bar — Complete Information Reference

## Business Profile
- **Entity**: Prados Restaurant & Bar
- **Industry**: Contemporary Dining, Charcoal Grills & Cocktail Lounge
- **Location**: 51 Alh. Bashorun Shittu Avenue, Magodo Phase 2, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 6.6194, Longitude 3.3768
- **Neighborhood**: Magodo GRA Phase 2, Lagos Mainland
- **Phone**: 0904 169 5561 (+234 904 169 5561)
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: 2349041695561
- **Email**: reservations@pradosrestaurant.com
- **Website**: https://prados-restaurant.vercel.app/

## Operating Hours & Dining Schedule
- **Monday**: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM

## Complete Verified Menu & Pricing (Nigerian Naira ₦)

### Starters & Small Plates
1. Crispy Peppered Calamari — ₦9,500
   Tender calamari rings dusted in spiced cassava flour, tossed in slow-cooked scotch bonnet relish with lime zest.
2. Smoked Goat Meat Asun Tartlets — ₦8,500
   Rich firewood-smoked diced goat meat seasoned with indigenous aromatic spices inside buttery shortcrust pastry.
3. Spiced Prawn & Yam Croquettes — ₦9,000
   Creamy mashed white yam infused with grilled jumbo prawns and spring onions, accompanied by roasted chili dip.

### Nigerian Main Courses
4. Prados Signature Jollof Feast — ₦14,000
   Firewood-infused smoky basmati jollof served with fried sweet plantain rosettes, moin-moin elewe, and choice of protein.
5. Slow-Braised Oxtail with Butter Yam Puree — ₦24,000
   Tender oxtail braised for six hours in rich tomato and scent leaf jus, paired with velvety roasted garlic yam mash.
6. Seafood Okra Supreme — ₦28,000
   Crunchy okra simmered with jumbo tiger prawns, calamari, blue crab, and fresh croaker fish, served with pounded yam.

### Charcoal Grills
7. Prime Lamb Chops in Suya Spice Crust — ₦32,000
   Flame-grilled succulent New Zealand lamb cutlets encrusted with artisanal yaji spice, charred shallots, and mint chutney.
8. Charcoal Whole Jumbo Croaker Fish — ₦22,000
   Fresh Atlantic croaker marinated in habanero-ginger marinade, slow-grilled over charcoal, garnished with peppers and sweet plantains.
9. Signature Peppered Turkey Wings — ₦13,500
   Crispy twice-cooked turkey wings tossed in rich, deeply caramelized bell pepper and habanero sauce.

## Reservation Guidelines
- Table reservations can be requested online at https://prados-restaurant.vercel.app/reservations
- Reservations are verified and confirmed by our host team via telephone or WhatsApp.
- Reserved tables are held for a grace period of 20 minutes before being released for walk-in guests.
- For parties of 8 or more, advance deposits may be requested to secure dedicated sections.
- Smart casual or sophisticated evening wear is encouraged.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Where is Prados Restaurant & Bar located?
Prados is located at 51 Alh. Bashorun Shittu Avenue, Magodo Phase 2, Lagos, Nigeria. It is centrally situated in Magodo GRA Phase 2 with ample gated security and dedicated vehicle parking.

### Does Prados accept reservations?
Yes. Guests can reserve tables online at https://prados-restaurant.vercel.app/reservations or by contacting the concierge directly at 0904 169 5561 or via WhatsApp at +234 904 169 5561.

### Can I host private events or birthday parties at Prados?
Yes. Prados accommodates private dining, birthdays, bridal showers, anniversaries, corporate mixers, and complete lounge takeovers. Custom multi-course menus, sound setups, and cake services are available. Enquiries can be submitted at https://prados-restaurant.vercel.app/private-events.

### Does Prados offer non-alcoholic beverages?
Yes. Our bar team prepares zero-proof artisan mocktails such as the house-steeped Zobo Bliss, fresh pressed juices, sodas, and sparkling mineral water.

### What are the parking and security conditions?
The venue is in a secure gated residential community in Magodo GRA Phase 2 with professional on-site security guards and designated guest parking.
